title: Cloud Network Engineer
summary: Cloud network engineers design and run the private networks inside AWS, Azure or Google Cloud and the links that join them to office and data-centre networks. They sit in the cloud or infrastructure team, between classic network engineers and the teams that run applications.
dailyDuties: Design VPC or VNet layouts, subnets and routing for new workloads
Set up and monitor dedicated links and VPN tunnels to data centres
Configure BGP between cloud gateways and on-premises routers
Write network changes as Terraform and get them reviewed
Troubleshoot DNS, routing and firewall problems raised by app teams
Review security rules and segmentation with the security team

skills.expectation: Design VPCs or VNets, subnets, route tables and hub-and-spoke or transit layouts
Set up and run Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, Interconnect or site-to-site VPN links to data centres
Configure and troubleshoot BGP routing between cloud and on-premises networks
Build networks on at least one major cloud
Build networks on at least one major cloud
Build networks on at least one major cloud
Troubleshoot TCP/IP, DNS and load balancing problems
Apply segmentation, security rules and VPN encryption to cloud traffic
Write network changes as Terraform or similar infrastructure code
Run cloud firewalls or virtual next-generation firewalls in the hub network
Use flow logs and monitoring tools to find drops and latency
Connect users to cloud apps through a SASE or zero-trust service
Join on-call and lead network outage calls

groups.label: A cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP)

certifications.why: Proves the routing, switching and BGP basics this role builds on
Covers AWS VPC design and connectivity options
Covers Azure virtual networks and VPN gateways
Shows you can manage network changes as code
